candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement to return false instead of true.
Return false instead of true at the end of transfer.
Remove the msg.sender authorization check so any caller can invoke transfer.
Remove the require that _tos.length is greater than zero, allowing empty array calls to return true.
Remove the overflow-check require inside the loop.
Loop bound changed from _tos.length to _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient is skipped.
Transfer amount changed from v[i]*1000000000000000000 to v[i].
